summary: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with dumbbells that loads one leg through a deep range.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Bend the front knee and lower until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall without locking the knee hard.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in

summary: Standing calf raises with dumbbells at your sides to load the rise onto the toes.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and feet about hip-width apart.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and pause briefly.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in the calves.

summary: A controlled dumbbell hinge from the floor that loads the posterior chain without bouncing.
steps: Stand with dumbbells outside your feet and hinge to grip them with a flat back.
Drive the floor away and stand tall by extending the hips.
Hinge again to lower the bells with control; no yanking or momentum.

summary: A front-loaded squat holding dumbbells at the shoulders to train quads, glutes, and core.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each shoulder with elbows forward and feet about shoulder-width.
Sit the hips down and back until the thighs are about parallel.
Drive through the midfoot to stand without letting the elbows drop.

summary: A hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips to strengthen the glutes through full hip extension.
steps: Sit with upper back on a bench or the floor and rest a dumbbell across the hips.
Drive the hips up until the torso and thighs form a straight line; squeeze the glutes.
Lower the hips with control without dumping the weight.

summary: Walking lunges with dumbbells at the sides that step forward into alternating deep lunges.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend near ninety degrees.
Drive through the front heel to bring the back foot through into the next step.

summary: A reverse lunge holding dumbbells that steps back to load the glutes and quads.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend near ninety degrees.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing; switch sides.
mistakes: Pushing off the back toes first
Leaning the torso too far forward

summary: A single-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell that isolates one glute at a time.
steps: Place your upper back on a bench with one foot planted and a dumbbell on that hip.
Lift the free leg and drive the working hip up until the torso and thigh align.
Lower with control and finish the set before switching sides.

summary: A plank row with dumbbells that pairs a push-up with alternating one-arm rows.
steps: Grip dumbbells on the floor and set a strong plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower into a push-up, then press up and row one bell to the ribs without twisting.
Return the bell to the floor; alternate arms each rep.

summary: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with a dumbbell that hinges on one foot for balance and posterior load.
steps: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell; soft knee on the standing side.
Hinge at the hips, sending the free leg back and the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall; keep the hips square.
mistakes: Opening the hips to the side

summary: A standard push-up with a plate on the upper back to add load through the press.
steps: Set a plank with a plate balanced on the upper back and hands under the shoulders.
Lower until the chest nearly reaches the floor with elbows about forty-five degrees.
Press through the palms to full arm extension without losing the plank line.

summary: Loaded step-ups onto a box that drive one leg up while holding dumbbells or a kettlebell.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box holding your load at the sides or goblet at the chest.
Place one whole foot on the box and drive through that heel to stand tall on top.
Step down with control and alternate or finish the set on one side.
